Chapter: 1. Getting Started: Opening OpenFrame Studio and Managing Projects
Scenario: Start the app from Start search and reach Home.
Steps: 1. Press the Windows key. 2. Type "openframe". 3. Press Enter. 4. Enter the team password the owner gave you. 5. Wait for Home.
Expected result: A window titled "OpenFrame Studio" opens. The start-up screen shows "Opening your local projects…" and then Home appears. No sign-in with an account is asked (only the team password).

Chapter: 1. Getting Started: Opening OpenFrame Studio and Managing Projects
Scenario: Start the app from the desktop icon.
Steps: 1. Close the app. 2. Double-click the OpenFrame Studio desktop icon. 3. Enter the team password.
Expected result: The app starts and shows Home. If no desktop icon exists, record SPEC GAP and use Start search.
